releaseNotes: Broad polish and quality-of-life release. Adds persistent library sorting and tab state, sort by title/artist/album/newest, manual library refresh and scan status, clearer search/empty states, album and artist artwork, real persistent shuffle and repeat modes, previous/next wraparound, elapsed/total playback time, artwork caching, song details and diagnostics, and delayed notification permission until playback. Metadata auto-fill is smoother with editable search terms, filename fallback, title-only fallback, deduplicated/ranked candidates, variant penalties, immediate field population, Revert, and unsaved-edit protection.
